💡 ember-p2p | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a decentralized, censorship-resistant social networking platform where users control their data and interactions without relying on central servers or algorithms.
✨ Key Features: • Serverless social network • No accounts, no central authority • Identity based on keypairs • Content replication by followers • Discovery via locality-sensitive hashing (LSH) and topic rooms
📖 Summary: Ember is a decentralized social network built on peer-to-peer technology, eliminating the need for central servers, accounts, or algorithms. It uses a keypair for identity and relies on users re-sharing content to keep it alive, with discovery based on topic proximity rather than popularity.
